target_native_profile.entities: The final text and its passages; recurring images and motifs; stylistic registers and voices; hypothesized compositional strata or hands; sources, editors, and publication context; the implied or anonymous author.
target_native_profile.relations: Passage echoes or repeats passage; register contrasts with register; passage precedes or follows in narrative order; feature is consistent or inconsistent with feature; passage depends on or reworks a source; hypothesized stratum contains passages.
target_native_profile.processes: Composition, revision, accretion, interpolation, editorial smoothing, and transmission alter the text; motifs develop or transform across the narrative; meaning accumulates through repetition.
target_native_profile.operations: Close reading; comparing passages and motifs; charting recurrence; noting continuity errors and register shifts; stylometric measurement where the critic uses it; checking publication records and paratexts; building and testing a hypothesis of formation against the whole text.
target_native_profile.observables: Repeated images; visible shifts in diction, syntax, tone, or narrative technique; internal contradictions and continuity errors; seams and abrupt transitions; paratextual and bibliographic facts.
target_native_profile.inferences: An account of the text's organization; tentative hypotheses about revision, layering, or multiple hands; attribution claims graded by the strength of internal and external evidence.
target_native_profile.failure_modes: Over-reading deliberate variation as a compositional seam; circular reasoning where the hypothesis selects its own evidence; non-uniqueness of explanations for heterogeneity; absence of drafts or witnesses leaving formation claims underdetermined; confirmation bias.

source_transfer_profile.entities: The formation history as a past event; latent residue as textual features that ordinary reading does not register (vestigial references, function-word profiles, orthographic or collocational habits); a probe as a specific diagnostic test applied uniformly across the text; responsive passages versus non-responsive background.
source_transfer_profile.relations: Residue is associated with, but does not prove, a formation event; the probe reacts with responsive material; the reaction is localized to a passage; responsive material may or may not derive from the suspected event.
source_transfer_profile.processes: Residue persists through revision and transmission; editorial smoothing removes or degrades residue; residue may fall below the sensitivity of the test; applying the probe may alter how the text can later be read or measured.
source_transfer_profile.operations: Choose a probe tuned to a suspected kind of residue (for example a rolling stylometric measure or a targeted marker search); apply it across the whole text rather than to suspected passages only; record where the response appears against an otherwise flat background; hold detection separate from any claim about the event.
source_transfer_profile.observables: A localized differential response: a passage that reacts to the probe when its neighbors do not. The visible discontinuity is not itself the evidence; the reaction to the test is.
source_transfer_profile.inferences: Licensed: responsive material is present and located here. Not licensed without more: that a revision or second hand produced it. The critic must construct a separate argument from the located material to the formation event.
source_transfer_profile.failure_modes: Unrelated causes (character voice, genre shift, pastiche) produce the same response; genuine revision traces were smoothed away or are below threshold; a located response does not establish the formation event; a heavy-handed probe (aggressive normalization, a hypothesis fixed before reading) contaminates later interpretation. The last counterpart is constructed and is the least secure part of the mapping.

entities.rationale: Traces, strata, and hands are already ordinary in textual and genetic criticism. Distinguishing a probe and a latent residue from the visible features a critic normally handles is a modest addition that does not reorganize the text into new kinds.

relations.rationale: Feature-indicates-stage and passage-derives-from-stage are native. The source adds a probe-reacts-with-material relation and an explicit gap between residue and event, which extends rather than reinterprets existing relations.

processes.rationale: Revision, smoothing, and transmission are native processes. Recasting them as persistence, removal, and degradation of residue is a slight reframing; the idea that a test can alter the material is unfamiliar but accommodable.

operations.rationale: Close reading is holistic and hypothesis-led. Applying one tuned test uniformly across the whole text and reading only where it lights up is a discipline critics do not usually impose, but rolling stylometric methods already do this, so it extends rather than replaces practice.

observables.rationale: Critics ordinarily treat visible discontinuities as the evidence. Shifting the evidence to a differential response under a test, aimed at features ordinary reading misses, changes what counts but stays within the existing category of internal textual evidence.

inferences.rationale: The source narrows the licensed conclusion to presence and location of responsive material, withholding the formation claim. Careful critics already distinguish stylistic difference from a second hand, so this tightens rather than reinterprets the inference rule.

failure_modes.rationale: False positives from deliberate variation, traces smoothed away, and detection not proving the event are all native cautions. Only probe contamination requires a constructed counterpart, and it maps loosely.

naturalization.evidence: Computational stylistics already uses rolling attribution and rolling delta methods to locate sections of a text that respond to a stylistic classifier, for example in studies of collaborative early modern plays. Genetic criticism treats the finished text as carrying traces of earlier states. Neither practice frames itself as luminol, and mainstream hermeneutic criticism of a single anonymous novel does not typically apply a uniform diagnostic probe before interpreting.
naturalization.rationale: The probe-and-localized-response structure is ordinary in one subspecialty of the target and unfamiliar in others. This partial naturalization pulls the class toward Native and rules out Remote; it keeps the case at Adjacent because for the general critic described in the packet the operation and the separation of detection from event inference are still an extension rather than a default move.

classification.class_rationale: Every dimension sits at extension. Target entities, observables, and inference rules remain recognizable; what the source adds is a discipline of applying a tuned test across the whole text, treating the differential response rather than the visible discontinuity as evidence, and withholding the formation claim until a second argument is made. The closest boundary is Native, because stylometric practitioners already do most of this without prompting from forensics. Regarding the hypothesis under test: this case shows a reasoner changing what they notice (latent rather than visible features) and what they infer (location rather than event) while still within Adjacent, which is mild evidence against the claim that such changes appear only at the Remote boundary. Support for the hypothesis is that no target object had to be treated as a different kind of thing.
uncertainty: The target domain is broad; a computational stylistician would find this Native, while a purely hermeneutic critic might experience the operations and observables as level 2.
The probe-alters-material limit has no clean counterpart in textual analysis; the contamination-of-later-reading mapping is constructed and could be judged arbitrary.

It is unclear whether a final printed text carries latent traces beyond the discontinuities already visible; if it does not, the probe operation has little to detect and the transfer collapses toward Native.
No information is given about the specific critic's methods or whether stylometry is part of their ordinary practice.
